title: affected.py record() keeps its clean probe before discover
findings_note: s355 relay 2026-10-17: record() in tests/affected.py takes its clean probe before its own discover, but no mutation test covers that order (s355 pinned the suite-side probe only)
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing map borrowing or the clean field.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: s355 pinned the clean probe at the start of the full discover that `tests/support.py` drives. `record()` in `tests/affected.py` has its own probe-then-discover order, and moving that probe after the discover probably passes the suite, so a tree cleaned mid-run could be recorded as clean.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - `tests/test_affected.py`: a test where the tree is dirty when `record()` starts and clean when it finishes records `clean: false`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Confirm the gap by mutation first; if a test already goes red, record that in the note and close the slice.
2. Otherwise write the test and confirm it goes red under the mutation.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
